title: Prehistoric Reborn
description: Prehistoric Reborn: is a Minecraft mod that transforms your world into a primal landscape. Discover fossils, extract ancient DNA, and use advanced technology to revive legendary creatures.
body:
Prehistoric Reborn
Experience the True Giants

Prehistoric Reborn focuses on bringing the ancient world to life through accurate and realistic design. Every creature is crafted with precision, honoring their true size and appearance as suggested by history.

Our goal is to populate your Minecraft world with the maximum number of dinosaurs possible, creating a massive and authentic ecosystem. No fantasy, no monsters—just the raw beauty and power of the prehistoric era.

Rebuild the past. Respect the giants. Survive the realism.

Dinossaur list: 

Tyrannosaurus Rex

Triceratops 

Velociraptor

Brachiosaurus

Spinosaurus

Stegosaurus (in progress)

Ankylosaurus (in progress)

Pteranodon (in progress)
